title: Meta's future AI data center lease obligations swell to over a quarter trillion dollars
excerpt: Meta said in a securities filing that it had about $278.99 billion in operating and finance leases that were not yet included on its balance sheet.
content_html:
By Natalie Musumeci

You're currently following this author! Want to unfollow? Unsubscribe via the link in your email.

Meta has more than a quarter trillion dollars in future lease obligations — largely tied to AI data centers — as the tech giant races to build out its artificial intelligence infrastructure, a new regulatory filing shows.

In its quarterly securities filing released a day after its earnings report, Meta said it had approximately $278.99 billion in operating and finance leases that have not yet begun and were not yet included on its balance sheet.

The lease agreements cover "data centers, colocations, and certain network infrastructure" and were scheduled to begin between the remainder of the year through 2036, Meta said in the filing. The lease terms range from more than one year to 30 years.

The nearly $279 billion figure represents a roughly 53% jump from the $182.88 billion in future lease obligations Meta reported in its first-quarter filings three months earlier.

Meta said in its latest securities filing that in July, after the quarter ended, it entered into additional data center leases with commitments of about $68 billion. Those leases are expected to begin in 2027 and 2028 with lease terms of 18 to 20 years, the company said.

The disclosures offer another glimpse into the extraordinary scale of Meta's AI infrastructure push.

Earlier this month, the owner of Facebook and Instagram announced plans to expand what was already expected to be its largest AI data center. Meta said that the Louisiana data center, known as Hyperion, will grow to 5 gigawatts of compute capacity, bringing the project's anticipated cost to more than $50 billion.

On Meta's second-quarter earnings call Wednesday, CEO Mark Zuckerberg said a "significant portion" of the company's computing capacity will be used to train its AI models, power AI agents, and support its core business. Zuckerberg added that Meta also expects to "grow a large business serving large customers as well."

Separate from its future lease obligations, Meta reported $349.31 billion in non-cancelable contractual commitments comprising both short-term and long-term arrangements.

"These commitments mostly relate to third-party cloud capacity arrangements and investments in servers and network infrastructure, data centers, and consumer hardware products in Reality Labs, with approximately $53.52 billion and $81.65 billion due in 2026 and 2027, respectively," Meta said in its filing.

Meta also said it has contingent obligations to purchase up to $14.72 billion of cloud capacity over the next five years. Those commitments "may be reduced if the cloud service provider is able to sell such capacity to other customers," Meta said.

一份新的监管文件显示，随着这家科技巨头竞相建设人工智能基础设施，Meta 未来的租赁义务将超过 25 万亿美元——主要与人工智能数据中心相关。

Meta 在其收益报告第二天发布的季度证券文件中表示，该公司约有 2,789.9 亿美元的经营和融资租赁尚未开始，也尚未纳入其资产负债表。

Meta 在文件中表示，租赁协议涵盖“数据中心、主机代管和某些网络基础设施”，计划在今年剩余时间到 2036 年之间开始。 租赁期限从一年以上至三十年不等。

近 2790 亿美元的数字比 Meta 三个月前在其第一季度文件中报告的 1828.8 亿美元的未来租赁义务增长了约 53%。

Meta 在最新的证券备案文件中表示，7 月份该季度结束后，该公司签订了额外的数据中心租赁协议，承诺金额约为 680 亿美元。 该公司表示，这些租赁预计将于 2027 年和 2028 年开始，租赁期限为 18 至 20 年。

这些披露让人们再次一睹 Meta 人工智能基础设施建设的非凡规模。

本月早些时候，Facebook 和 Instagram 的所有者宣布计划扩建原本预计将成为其最大的人工智能数据中心。 Meta 表示，路易斯安那州数据中心（称为 Hyperion）的计算能力将增至 5 吉瓦，使该项目的预期成本超过 500 亿美元。

在周三举行的 Meta 第二季度财报电话会议上，首席执行官马克·扎克伯格表示，公司计算能力的“很大一部分”将用于训练其人工智能模型、为人工智能代理提供动力并支持其核心业务。 扎克伯格补充说，Meta 还希望“发展为大客户提供服务的大型业务”。

除了未来的租赁义务外，Meta 还报告了 3,493.1 亿美元的不可撤销合同承诺，包括短期和长期安排。

Meta 在其文件中表示：“这些承诺主要涉及第三方云容量安排以及对 Reality Labs 的服务器和网络基础设施、数据中心和消费硬件产品的投资，预计 2026 年和 2027 年分别约为 535.2 亿美元和 816.5 亿美元。”

Meta 还表示，它有或有义务在未来五年内购买高达 147.2 亿美元的云容量。 Meta 表示，“如果云服务提供商能够将此类容量出售给其他客户，这些承诺可能会减少”。
